look_here_first: Look for paired straight stipular spines, finely divided compound leaves and golden spherical flower heads. A short, swollen hard dark mature pod distinguishes huisache from whitethorn.

best_field_traits: Paired straight stipular spines at leaves
Bipinnate leaves with many narrow leaflets
Bright golden fragrant spherical flower heads
Hard swollen dark brown to black mature pod

comparisons.key_distinctions: Very thick mature pod favors huisache over whitethorn's long slender pod.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas native state-level Kew POWO; strict project 24-county count not complete.
